automations.name: typeahead refresh missing -> retry + discord
automations.description: A serving Tantivy slot's checkpoint coverage lasts 24 hours and refreshes run at 06:00 and 18:00 UTC, so one missed run leaves no margin. On 2026-11-02 the 06:00 run crashed and its generic failure line went unnoticed until search was stale twelve hours later. When no typeahead-index run completes for 13 hours this retries the automatic refresh at once and says what is at stake. The deployment's concurrency limit cancels the retry if a run is already active.

actions.subject: typeahead refresh missed: retry started
actions.body: No typeahead-index run has completed in 13 hours. The serving Tantivy slot reports stale 24 hours after its checkpoint. A retry of the automatic refresh has started; if it fails too, act now: https://prefect-server.waow.tech/deployments and https://typeahead.waow.tech/health/freshness
